SELECT CASE WHEN sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' THEN 'PY' WHEN sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25' THEN 'CY' END AS per,
 count(*) lines, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) dist_lines, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) dist_rl,
 sum(net_amount) net, sum(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN net_amount END) staff_net,
 count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) loads, min(etl_loaded_at), max(etl_loaded_at),
 sum(CASE WHEN net_amount<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos, sum(CASE WHEN channel_code='WB' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) web_lines,
 min(sale_date), max(sale_date)
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' OR sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25'
GROUP BY 1

SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name,
 sum(CASE WHEN r.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' THEN r.net_sales END) py_net,
 sum(CASE WHEN r.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25' THEN r.net_sales END) cy_net,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' THEN r.business_date END) py_days,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25' THEN r.business_date END) cy_days,
 count(*) n, count(DISTINCT (r.business_date, r.store_id)) dn
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT store_id, store_name FROM dim_store) s USING (store_id)
WHERE r.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' OR r.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

WITH per AS (
 SELECT DATE '2024-10-28' s, DATE '2025-01-26' e, 'PY' p UNION ALL SELECT DATE '2025-10-27', DATE '2026-01-25', 'CY'),
sal AS (
 SELECT st.store_id, per.p, sum(f.net_amount) gross_net, sum(f.net_amount) FILTER (WHERE f.staff_purchase_flag) staff, sum(f.net_amount) FILTER (WHERE f.channel_code='WB') webnet
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st USING (store_key) JOIN per ON f.sale_date BETWEEN per.s AND per.e GROUP BY 1,2),
ret AS (
 SELECT st.store_id, per.p, sum(r.refund_net) refunds
 FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st USING (store_key) JOIN per ON r.return_date BETWEEN per.s AND per.e GROUP BY 1,2),
rp AS (
 SELECT r.store_id, per.p, sum(net_sales_before_returns) nsbr, sum(returns_net) rn, sum(net_sales) ns
 FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN per ON r.business_date BETWEEN per.s AND per.e GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT rp.store_id, rp.p, rp.nsbr, sal.gross_net, round(rp.nsbr - sal.gross_net,2) d_sales, rp.rn, ret.refunds, round(rp.rn-coalesce(ret.refunds,0),2) d_ret, sal.staff, sal.webnet
FROM rp LEFT JOIN sal USING (store_id,p) LEFT JOIN ret USING (store_id,p)
WHERE abs(rp.nsbr - coalesce(sal.gross_net,0))>0.01 OR abs(rp.rn-coalesce(ret.refunds,0))>0.01 OR sal.webnet IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT d.fiscal_week, r.store_id,
 sum(CASE WHEN r.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' THEN r.net_sales END) py,
 sum(CASE WHEN r.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25' THEN r.net_sales END) cy
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
WHERE r.store_id IN (119,129,136) AND (r.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' OR r.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25')
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2,1

WITH x AS (
 SELECT f.*, st.store_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st USING (store_key)
 WHERE st.store_id<900 AND (f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' OR f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25')),
dups AS (SELECT count(*) n FROM (SELECT store_id, sale_ts_utc, product_key, quantity, net_amount, member_key, count(*) c FROM x GROUP BY ALL HAVING count(*)>1)),
big AS (SELECT max(net_amount) mx, quantile_cont(net_amount,0.999) p999, min(quantity) minq, max(quantity) maxq FROM x),
vat AS (SELECT count(*) bad FROM x WHERE abs(gross_amount - net_amount*(1+vat_rate))>0.02),
rec AS (SELECT count(*) n FROM (SELECT receipt_id FROM x GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(DISTINCT store_id)>1 OR count(DISTINCT sale_date)>1))
SELECT dups.n dup_groups, big.*, vat.bad, rec.n multi_store_receipts FROM dups, big, vat, rec

calls.statement:
WITH cur AS (
  SELECT store_id, region FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND store_id < 900
),
lfl_stores AS (
  SELECT c.store_id, c.region
  FROM cur c
  JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT store_id, open_date FROM dim_store) o USING (store_id)
  WHERE (o.open_date IS NULL OR o.open_date <= DATE '2023-10-28')
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure z WHERE z.store_id = c.store_id
        AND z.closure_start_date <= DATE '2026-01-25' AND z.closure_end_date >= DATE '2024-10-28'
        AND NOT (z.closure_end_date < DATE '2025-10-27' AND z.closure_start_date > DATE '2025-01-26'))
),
sales AS (
  SELECT l.region,
    sum(r.net_sales) FILTER (WHERE r.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26') AS py_net,
    sum(r.net_sales) FILTER (WHERE r.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25') AS cy_net,
    count(DISTINCT l.store_id) AS stores
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN lfl_stores l USING (store_id)
  GROUP BY l.region
)
SELECT region, stores AS lfl_store_count, round(py_net,2) AS prior_year_net_sales, round(cy_net,2) AS net_sales, round((cy_net/py_net-1)*100,2) AS lfl_growth_pct,
  'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 3 AS fiscal_quarter
FROM sales ORDER BY region

WITH cur AS (
  SELECT store_id, region FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND store_id < 900
),
lfl_stores AS (
  SELECT c.store_id, c.region
  FROM cur c
  JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT store_id, open_date FROM dim_store) o USING (store_id)
  WHERE (o.open_date IS NULL OR o.open_date <= DATE '2023-10-28')
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure z WHERE z.store_id = c.store_id
        AND z.closure_start_date <= DATE '2026-01-25' AND z.closure_end_date >= DATE '2024-10-28')
),
sales AS (
  SELECT l.region,
    sum(r.net_sales) FILTER (WHERE r.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26') AS py_net,
    sum(r.net_sales) FILTER (WHERE r.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25') AS cy_net
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN lfl_stores l USING (store_id)
  GROUP BY l.region
)
SELECT region, 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 3 AS fiscal_quarter, round((cy_net/py_net-1)*100,2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM sales ORDER BY region
